dataset: QASC (Khot, Clark, Guerquin, Jansen and Sabharwal, 2020), CC BY -- train+validation (the annotated splits; the public test split has no answer key or facts), each an 8-way multiple-choice science question with two retrieved facts fact1/fact2 and a combinedfact stating their composition

examples.fact2: condensation is the change of water vapor to a liquid.
examples.combinedfact: vapor turning into a liquid leaves behind beads of water

note: For each annotated QASC question the gold answer is the choice whose label == answerKey and the distractors are the other choices. 'gold in <field>' = the normalized gold text is a non-empty substring of the normalized fact field (fact1, fact2 or combinedfact); the same test is applied to each distractor. gold_rate_<field> = valid questions whose gold is in that field / valid questions; dist_rate_<field> = distractor-in-field hits / total distractors (option count controlled). n_gold_in_either_single counts valid questions whose gold is in fact1 or fact2; n_gold_in_combined_not_single counts those whose gold is in the combinedfact but in neither single fact -- the composition-only leaks. Text is lowercased and whitespace-collapsed only (punctuation kept), so every rate is a conservative lower bound. Rows whose answerKey matches no choice are malformed and excluded; rows with no answerKey are unannotated and excluded.
